h1_1 = rightmost(!is_sym0@i & !is_sym3@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & !is_sym2@j & is_sym3@j | !is_sym1@i & !is_sym3@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & is_sym2@j, !is_sym3@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j | !is_sym3@i & !is_sym0@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & is_sym2@i & !is_sym3@i & !is_bos@j & is_sym1@j & is_sym2@j | !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j & !is_sym2@j, !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & is_sym2@i | !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_sym0@j)
accept = !is_sym2 & !h1_1 & !h1_2

output accept
